problem_text:
A logistics company must allocate its fleet capacity across 7 distinct delivery routes, each necessitating passage through 7 specialized checkpoints. The revenue generated per ton of cargo on each route is specified below:
* For Route Alpha, revenue is 5.409 per ton
* For Route Beta, revenue is 8.49 per ton
* For Route Gamma, revenue is 17.309 per ton
* For Route Delta, revenue is 11.261 per ton
* For Route Epsilon, revenue is 18.253 per ton
* For Route Zeta, revenue is 19.154 per ton
* For Route Eta, revenue is 8.65 per ton

The handling duration required per ton of cargo at each checkpoint is as follows:
* For Route Alpha, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.208 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.786 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.247 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.502 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.646 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.978 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.739 (ton-hours)
* For Route Beta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.762 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.631 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.536 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.499 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.622 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.725 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.312 (ton-hours)
* For Route Gamma, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.502 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.11 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.582 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.16 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.088 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.428 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.355 (ton-hours)
* For Route Delta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.221 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.685 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.347 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.931 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.971 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.542 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.011 (ton-hours)
* For Route Epsilon, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.696 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.942 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.822 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.913 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.507 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.807 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.484 (ton-hours)
* For Route Zeta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.637 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.578 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.282 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.738 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.12 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.321 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.003 (ton-hours)
* For Route Eta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.011 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.6 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.571 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.442 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.328 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.117 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.224 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 1 must not surpass 80.348 hours
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 2 must not surpass 139.829 hours
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 3 must not surpass 72.824 hours
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 4 must not surpass 91.987 hours
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 5 must not surpass 114.778 hours
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 6 must not surpass 114.899 hours
* The cumulative handling duration at Checkpoint 7 must not surpass 47.744 hours

Given the imperative to ensure that for each checkpoint—Checkpoint 1, Checkpoint 2, Checkpoint 3, Checkpoint 4, Checkpoint 5, Checkpoint 6, Checkpoint 7—the total processing duration does not exceed its allotted availability, determine the optimal cargo allocation across routes to maximize total revenue.
